title: Ontario police identify man who died after being felled by a taser
article: Ontario's Special Investigations Unit yesterday identified Jeffrey Mark Marreel as the man who died on Monday after he was felled by police using a Taser.

Ontario Provincial Police said the 36-year-old, of no fixed address, was being combative and was disturbing others during an incident on Monday morning at the beach hamlet of Turkey Point, on Lake Erie, about 130 kilometres southwest of Toronto.
Officers said ambulance personnel were at the scene and the man was taken into police custody. He was then transported to the OPP Norfolk County detachment, where he collapsed.
When reached at home by Canwest News Service, the man's father, Noel Marreel said he was not supposed to say anything over the phone anymore.
Earlier the Canadian Press reported that the elder Marreel said his son was depressed after losing his job, breaking up with his girlfriend and had a history of drug use.
